label: early-episode a2 streak: rewarded D1 / S2 shown at D2 while committed to a2
explanation: Update-gate unit 2 fires almost only on trials where the agent picks a2 (100% of activation mass has action==2; it essentially never fires on a1 trials or on switch trials). It is also restricted to early in the episode: about 96% of the mass falls in ep_trial < 30, it decays over trials 20-39 and is silent after about trial 40. Within those trials it fires at D1 when the previous reward is shown as 1 (in_rew==1 carries 68% of the mass, and D1 has 70%) and at D2 when S2 is the state shown (26%). It is mostly off at GO, never fires when S1 is shown or with a1 as the input, and is enriched when S2 is the good state and in episodes that start with S2 good. The strongest activations come in long runs of rewarded a2 choices and decline slowly along the run. The policy logit is moderately negative (a weak-to-moderate a2 preference) when it fires. The predicate covers about 90% of the mass on dev but has precision of only about 0.56: the unit is not active on many early-episode a2 D1/D2 steps, apparently depending on how long the a2 streak has lasted, which the predicate cannot express. At D1 the predicate uses action, the agent own upcoming choice (formally FUTURE, but legitimately computed by the agent). The fully observed alternative using prev_action==2 scores F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.70 on dev because it misses each window first trial, so the action version was recorded.
